summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026 reporting that its board granted 35,890 employee warrants on October 13, 2026 under Appendix 1a of its Articles, with an exercise price of US$223.21 per share, the grant-date closing price. Warrants vest 25% at one year and the remaining 75% monthly over 36 months thereafter, subject to service and certain exit-event acceleration. Following the grant, 1,459,173 shares remain available for future grants. This is a routine equity-compensation disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisor, or change of control.
